combo_only.about: Album-colour hint (Tiffany Oct 20 late, item J): an album's set colours are a HINT for missed colours, not a rule. Each album mat gets its set's colours as COMBO-ONLY colours (row field 10, FYM 'ha'; never a single-colour section) only where the mat photo measures >= 5% of that colour (blue + teal pooled for the blue/teal test). Never added when she removed that colour for the mat (corrections 'remove'). Derived by build_v5.py from site/livepatch/matgallery/album_combo_audit_oct20.json set colours + scratch album membership, list frozen in config/mat-album-combo-colors.json.
